matrix_name.name: Polydimethylsiloxane
matrix_name.description: PDMS (base agent + hardener mixed 10:1 mass ratio; 5 wt% diluent added relative to PDMS solution for processing).

fillers.name: Boron nitride
fillers.description: Boron nitride nanoribbons (BNNR) arranged as vertically aligned array/aerogel skeleton; heat-treated at 1700 °C in Ar before composite impregnation.

fillers.name: Graphene
fillers.description: Vertical graphene (VG) grown in situ on BNNR surfaces by low-pressure CVD (CH3OH carbon source), VG growth time = 2 h; forms VG-BNNR hybrid filler.
